secondary_sources.publisher: Alpha Finance / Block Media Pty Ltd
limits: Alpha Finance identifies Coinglass as its ETF dashboard feed.
The page says five of five funds were included in the latest zero-flow session.
It does not publish fund AUM or holdings; cumulative flow is not current assets.
Net flow is not gross creations/redemptions or an issuer/custodian record.
Independence from other Coinglass-derived dashboards is not established.
Analyst/provider wallet attribution, not a Binance exchange statement.
CryptoQuant explicitly warns that some movement may be internal transfers.
Exchange-wallet outflow is not proof of net accumulation or new buying.
No destination-wallet classification or independent exchange confirmation was captured.

secondary_sources.publisher: Alpha Finance / Block Media Pty Ltd
limits: Clusters are modelled from open interest and leverage tiers, not actual resting liquidation orders.
All-exchange aggregation can conceal a single venue carrying most of a cluster.
Snapshot is 43 minutes older than the run reference.
Exact source-level OI contribution is not fully exposed in the excerpt.
The provider states its liquidation map is not a directional forecast.

derived.same_venue_change_warning: Snapshot-to-snapshot last-price change only; not a continuous trade return, OHLC candle return or proof of sustained recovery. Not admitted as a feature.

hypotheses.statement: The reported 418.5M XRP Binance outflow could reflect accumulation, internal movement or wallet reclassification; it is not proof of new buying.
Alpha Finance reports zero net XRP ETF flow on November 6 across five funds, but this is a Coinglass-fed aggregator series rather than issuer-confirmed gross creations/redemptions or holdings.
Alpha Finance's displayed short-liquidation model is larger above spot than its long-liquidation model below spot, but it does not establish that price will move upward.

reasons: OKX snapshot is 354.232 seconds old, exceeding the 300-second live freshness limit.
USD and USDT quote currencies are not normalized.
No synchronized multi-level depth or continuous OHLC history was captured.
ETF flow and wallet-attribution excerpts are secondary provider observations, not issuer or exchange primary records.
Liquidation clusters are modelled estimates, not actual resting orders.
